forwarded.subject: Your trade account refund
forwarded.body: Hello from Larkspur Supply Co. Because of a billing error last month, your trade account is owed a refund of $412.80. To receive it today, reply with the card number on the account and the three digit code on the back. This offer ends on Friday, so please act quickly.
